title: Smaller than thought.
text:
Smaller than thought.. This is not a good value. The bottle are nothing special and the wired basket is cheaply made. I gave it 3 stars anyway because it is cute.

The middle bottle was broken when I opened it

BATHROOM DÉCOR - This caddy would be right at home on the bathroom countertop or vanity, hold cotton balls, cue tips, makeup brushes, hair ties, or any other personal products for easy access.
EASY CARE - Simply wipe the caddy with a damp cloth when necessary. Glass vases are dishwasher safe.
